official_sources.title: OGC COG HTTP byte-range requirements
official_sources.finding: The COG standard requires servers to support TIFF delivery and HTTP byte ranges so clients can retrieve the header, IFDs and only the tiles required for a requested area.
official_sources.limitation: Range support improves access efficiency but does not prove that separately retrieved ranges belong to one immutable representation.

official_sources.title: GDAL COG layout and update protection
official_sources.finding: GDAL describes tiled COG layout optimized for random network reads and rejects update-mode opening by default when an update could break COG organization.
official_sources.limitation: A valid GeoTIFF can still cease to be cloud optimized after modification; structural validation must be rerun after materialization or metadata changes.

official_sources.title: GDAL COG full structural validation
official_sources.finding: The COG validator can perform extensive leading and trailer byte checks for strips or tiles; automatic mode performs those checks locally but not for remote files.
official_sources.limitation: A remote validation success without full checks is insufficient for final integrity acceptance; the asset should be materialized and fully checked.

official_sources.title: GDAL VSICurl cache invalidation controls
official_sources.finding: GDAL network virtual filesystems cache downloaded content and provide non-cached path configuration and explicit cache-clearing controls for resources that may change.
official_sources.limitation: Reopening a URL can reuse old bytes unless cache identity and invalidation are controlled.

official_sources.title: GDAL bounded HTTP retry and low-speed controls
official_sources.finding: GDAL exposes maximum retry, retry-code, connection timeout and low-speed cancellation controls, and documents a shared curl content cache that can persist across reopened file handles.
official_sources.limitation: Unlimited or hidden retries can mask unstable sources; retries must remain bounded and must not combine cached bytes from different representations.

official_sources.title: HTTP strong validators for range consistency
official_sources.finding: HTTP If-Range allows a range request only when the selected representation still matches a validator; weak entity tags are not allowed for If-Range.
official_sources.limitation: A missing or weak validator cannot safely bind multiple partial downloads to one immutable asset version.

official_sources.title: HTTP Content-Digest with SHA-256
official_sources.finding: The Content-Digest field communicates a digest calculated over actual HTTP message content and supports registered algorithms including SHA-256.
official_sources.limitation: A digest header is trustworthy only when transported and bound securely; when absent, a locally computed SHA-256 must be recorded against the downloaded blob.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster checksum width
official_sources.finding: GDAL band checksum computes a 16-bit value in the range 0–65535.
official_sources.limitation: A 16-bit checksum is useful for quick diagnostics but cannot replace SHA-256 or another cryptographic blob identity.

candidates.name: Cryptographic blob and diagnostic raster checksum chain
